Replacing each finite atom by a sufficiently narrow separated symmetric bump and using a common bump draw when the two death categories agree yields a bounded-Lipschitz law satisfying all maintained conditions with the same strict separation; the separation persists on a relatively open neighborhood.
body.justification: A robust strict example establishes that the joint surface theorem adds identifying content beyond a collection of exact pointwise intervals.
body.gap: Generic warnings that pointwise sharp bounds need not be jointly sharp do not give a legal semicompeting-risk region with binding survivor capacities and exact support certificates.
body.consumer: It tells applied users when horizon-by-horizon uncertainty bands are mathematically incompatible and can reverse conclusions about signed clinical summaries.
